_about: R4.2 NSFont text styles, control sizes, named UI fonts, SF Pro tracking/optical size per point size, and R4.3 text-sample layout. macOS 27.2.1 (26B131), measured in-process with AppKit/CoreText (no defaults changed). Units: points unless noted; font units = 1/2048 em (SFNS upm 2048).

findings.systemFontFile: /System/Library/Fonts/SFNS.ttf (".SF NS", 22.0d5e1), variable: wdth 30..150, opsz 17..96 (default 28), GRAD 400..1000, wght 1..1000. All text styles resolve to .SFNS-* instances of this file.
findings.opticalSize: opsz axis = point size, clamped to [17,96]. <=17 pt -> opsz 17 = SF Pro Text design (n advance 583.496/1000 em, identical to static SFProText-Regular). 18..27 pt -> continuous interpolation. >=28 pt -> advances identical to static SFProDisplay-Regular (526.855/1000 em); opsz keeps rising to 96 but advances do not change after 28 (outline changes beyond 28 not measured). No discrete Text/Display switch at 20 pt any more.
findings.tracking: Tracking is baked into glyph advances by CoreText from the SFNS trak table, track "Normal" (0.0), selected by POINT SIZE (not the clamped opsz), linearly interpolated between table sizes; fractional interpolated unit values are truncated (25 pt: 11.5 -> 11, 27 pt: 22.5 -> 22, 29 pt: 27.5 -> 27, 34 pt: 23.5 -> 23). trackingPt = units * size / 2048. Same per glyph (spread 0 across n,H,o,0,a). NSAttributedString .tracking/.kern 0 do not remove it. Method: advance of system font at size S minus advance of the same font file with all axes pinned to the same values at 100 pt (trak Normal = 0 at >=80 pt), scaled to S.
findings.lineHeight: lineHeight = NSLayoutManager.defaultLineHeight(for:) and equals ascender - descender + leading exactly (an integer for every style: 32/26/22/20/16/14/16/15/13/13/13); SF leading is nonzero and size dependent. NSCTFontSizeCategoryAttribute = 3 for all styles (no Dynamic Type scaling on macOS).
findings.weights: Descriptor weight trait is 0 for every style except headline (0.4 = bold); caption2 reports trait 0 but resolves to .SFNS-Medium (wght axis 510). headline = .SFNS-Bold (wght 700). All others .SFNS-Regular (wght 400).
